title: Silent Signals, Loud Impact: LLMs for Word-Sense Disambiguation of Coded Dog Whistles

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLMs' ability to detect and define racially coded language (e.g., racist and white supremacist dog whistles) using word-sense disambiguation and prompting techniques on congressional speeches and social media text.

Assessing models' capabilities to identify and explain covert political dog whistles (e.g., anti-liberal, conservative) through zero-shot, few-shot, and ensemble prompting approaches to extract targeted groups.
Measuring LLMs' accuracy in recognizing transphobic, homophobic, and anti-LGBTQ coded terminology by asking models to differentiate between innocuous and harmful contexts of specific keywords.
Testing the models on their capacity to resolve antisemitic and Islamophobic dog whistles from standard speech using definition generation and context disambiguation tasks.
